problem: 'Not at all 才是答應' is overgeneralised: Americans routinely agree to 'Would you mind…?' with 'No problem', 'Sure' or 'Of course not', so he would wrongly eliminate those replies.
fix: Would you mind 是請求 → Not at all／No problem 都表示答應

problem: Claims Yes cannot respond to a statement, which is false ('The printer is out of paper.' 'Yes, I noticed.' is natural); the reply fails only on content.
fix: newspaper 含 paper，但看報紙與沒紙無關

problem: broken/break is not a topic-associated word; it plays on a different sense of break (休息 vs 打破), i.e. a multiple-meaning trap.
